title: Intune Data Warehouse policy counts may shift from 4 Jan 2027
summary: Message Center MC1565960 (23 November 2026): from 4 January 2027, or soon after, Microsoft moves policy-related reporting in the Intune Data Warehouse onto the updated Intune reporting infrastructure. Seven collections are affected: policyDeviceActivities, policyTypeActivities, policyUserActivities, deviceConfigurationProfileDeviceActivities, deviceConfigurationProfileUserActivities, compliancePolicyStatusDeviceActivities and compliancePolicyStatusDevicePerPolicyActivities. Connections and schemas stay the same, but policy-status counts may change. Microsoft also notes that Data Warehouse counts can differ from the Intune admin center because of refresh timing and aggregation.
why: Compliance dashboards in Power BI and audit evidence built on these collections may show a step change in early January that has nothing to do with your devices. Without a baseline, that looks like a compliance drop or gain and will cost someone a day to explain.
todo: Do now: find Power BI reports and exports that use the seven collections and tell their owners about the January change.
In the last week of December, save a snapshot of current policy and compliance counts as a baseline.
After 4 January, compare against the baseline before reporting trends; don't reconcile Data Warehouse and admin center numbers one to one.
Wait: no configuration change is required.
effective_note: From 4 January 2027 or soon after, per MC1565960.
